The '''Road to Renewal''', also known as the '''Path of Pilgrimage''', was a roadway that led through the [[Serenity Valley]] in the [[Old Paths]] region of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Voss]] to the [[Shrine of Healing]]. The [[Pilgrim Retreat]] was located along the roadway.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Road to Renewal appears as a location in the Old Paths on Voss in the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="TOR" />
